rationale: The stock is at 98.6% of its intraday range, just $0.02 below the session high of $13.21, after a large gap-up move of ~9.6% from prior close. With only 33 minutes to close, the risk/reward for a long is poor — chasing at the top of a extended range with minimal room before the high and forced liquidation at close. A short against the high is tempting given the exhaustion signals (declining volume on last candles, price stalling at $13.20-13.21), but the strong momentum and elevated relative volume (4.54x) make a breakout squeeze possible, and the ATR is too small relative to spread to define a clean risk level. No trade offers a favorable setup.
